title: Vision Plans Out-of-Network Contact-Lens Amount: Medical Necessity and Glasses in the Same Period
content:
On an out-of-network claim settled on its contact-lens part, the contact-lens line is settled as follows.

1. **Glasses counting in the period.** When a spectacle-lens or frame service of the same person counts in the claim's benefit period, the contact-lens line and its fitting line are not reimbursed. They are denied as contacts in lieu of glasses, and the contact-lens amount is 0.00.
2. **Certified medically necessary.** Otherwise, when the provider certified the contact lenses as medically necessary (the contact-lens reason on the line), the line receives the plan's out-of-network medically necessary contact-lens amount.
3. **Elective.** Otherwise the line receives the plan's out-of-network elective amount.

**When a spectacle-lens or frame service counts.** It counts when it is the latest service of its kind (spectacle lenses and frames each being a kind of their own) of the enrollment whose remark is paid or out-of-network reimbursement paid, and its date of service falls in the same benefit period as the claim, whatever its order against it. A lone reversed latest service on its date counts as none, with no earlier one looked at; of several on that date, a reversal of one leaves that date standing. The benefit period is the twelve-month period starting each year on the enrollment's benefit-period reset day.

| Plan | Medically necessary amount | Elective amount |
|---|---|---|
| Cascade Vision Exam Plus | 0.00 | 0.00 |
| Cascade Vision Essential 100 | 210.00 | 85.00 |
| Cascade Vision Select 130 | 210.00 | 105.00 |
| Cascade Vision Select 150 | 210.00 | 105.00 |
| Cascade Vision Choice 175 | 210.00 | 120.00 |
| Cascade Vision Premier 200 | 210.00 | 150.00 |

*Hypothetical case.* A member with no glasses paid in the period files for certified contact lenses with a receipt of 244.10 on Cascade Vision Select 150. The line meets an amount of 210.00; uncertified, it would meet 105.00.
